subject: Procurement & vendor setup: next steps for Redwood trial
messages:

Subject: Follow-up: procurement & vendor setup for Redwood trial

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal: 30-day pilot of Redwood inference for Acme’s customer support summarization pipeline.
- Technical next step: Nikhil will share the minimal onboarding checklist (model selection + test dataset) — he’s CC’d.
- Procurement/commercial: we need to confirm how Acme prefers to pay (PO vs card), and complete any vendor setup paperwork so your finance team can issue a PO.

I’ve attached a short vendor intake form to speed things up (vendor_intake_form.pdf) — if you can fill and return that, plus your preferred billing method, we’ll queue Legal/Finance here. Also: do you want us to enroll Redwood in the AWS Marketplace for this purchase, or would you prefer a direct PO to Redwood Inference?

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmeanalytics.com>

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary. Procurement prefers to pay via PO for all new vendors. Happy to move forward — I’ve attached our standard vendor setup packet, our W-9, and a bank details template you can fill out.

Quick answers:
- Payment method: PO (net 30)
- Timeline: once we receive a completed vendor packet + W-9 + banking info, procurement estimates 5–7 business days to issue a PO.
- Vendor portal: we use a self-serve vendor portal (link below) where you can upload documents; if you prefer, we can accept emailed attachments and we’ll upload them internally.

Attachments: vendor_setup_packet.pdf, W-9_Acme.pdf, bank_details_form.xlsx
Link: https://vendor-portal.acmeanalytics.com/onboard/8462

Let me know if you need our tax/PO contact for the purchase order.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director, Strategic Programs — Acme Analytics
samantha.lee@acmeanalytics.com

Hi Samantha — thanks, that timeline works. I’ve filled out the vendor intake form and attached a signed Redwood W-9 for your records (Redwood_W9.pdf). For the vendor packet you sent: a couple quick items so your procurement team has everything in one place:

- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789
- Primary billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (we can provide a named contact if you need one on the PO)
- Banking: I’ve started completing bank_details_form.xlsx — pushing final copy by end of day tomorrow.

We can upload directly to your vendor portal (please confirm the preferred account/email to use), or I can email the completed packet back to procurement@acmeanalytics.com. Also, we’re happy to enroll in AWS Marketplace if that’s helpful for internal purchasing — will that make the process faster for you?

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf; completed_vendor_intake_form.pdf (in progress)

Thanks — looping Nikhil for any technical questions.

Marissa
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement paperwork for Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our side before we route to finance: 

1) Vendor portal account — please use vendor@redwood.ai to create the portal account and upload the packet. Once uploaded, reply to this thread with the portal upload confirmation ID.
2) DocuSign — we can accept DocuSign for signatures; if you prefer that, we’ll send an envelope to the billing contact.
3) AWS Marketplace — enrolling doesn't change our internal PO process; it can sometimes add Marketplace-specific terms that require additional review. If your team prefers the fastest route to a PO, a direct vendor setup + emailed packet is quickest.

If you can get the final bank_details_form.xlsx and signed W-9 uploaded today, we’ll aim to issue a PO by end of next week.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acmeanalytics.com

Expected timeline: upload today (Marissa) → Acme issues PO within 5–7 business days per your estimate. Laura will follow up if we haven’t received a PO by 2026-07-24.
